scope.packages: Runtime entry import closures of six published packages; package proof/test harnesses excluded.

classes.types.base: Base type or type-level definition in a signature/annotation.
classes.generics: Datatype/type parameters or parameterized datatype applications.
classes.dependent: A type refers to an earlier bound parameter.
classes.fields: Non-nullary constructor declaration, construction or pattern.
classes.quantities.polymorphic: Quant parameter or computed kind/quantity meet.
classes.literals.nat: Nat literal or numeric Nat pattern.
classes.captures: Expression lambda references a surrounding local binder.
classes.higher-order: Function-valued parameter in a definition signature.
classes.calls.variable: Application headed by a bound variable.
classes.calls.partial: Named definition applied to fewer than its declared parameters.
classes.function-values: Named non-nullary definition used as a value.
classes.recursion: Direct reference to this declaration from its body.
classes.matches.multi: More than one scrutinee in a single match.
classes.patterns.nested: Constructor pattern contains a constructor pattern.
classes.templates: Template declaration or reference to a template.
classes.io: Reference to IO or File operations/types.
classes.arrays: Reference to Base Array or its constructors/operations.
